characters.summary: Aberforth Dumbledore is a skilled and practical wizard who prefers direct action over complex spells. He operates the Hog's Head inn and is proficient in dueling and Defensive Magic, notably producing a powerful goat Patronus.

sources.supports: Aberforth's magical abilities, Hog's Head ownership, and Patronus charm.

feats.claim: Conjured a powerful goat Patronus to save Harry Potter, Hermione Granger, and Ron Weasley from Dementors.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of Hogwarts, defeating multiple Death Eaters.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated Rookwood during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Casts complex defensive and offensive magic as a wizard.

unknowns: Exact extent of his dueling capabilities compared to his brother Albus is not fully detailed.

characters.summary: Alastor 'Mad-Eye' Moody is a legendary Auror renowned for his paranoia, combat experience, and extensive use of dark-wizard-catching techniques. He possesses a magical eye that sees through walls, invisibility, and solid objects.
weaknesses: Physical impairment due to missing leg and eye
Overconfidence in static hiding spots when ambushed
limitations: Physical disabilities resulting from injuries sustained in the line of duty.

sources.supports: Alastor Moody's Auror background, magical eye, and combat exploits.

feats.claim: Captured or killed numerous Death Eaters, filling half of the cells in Azkaban.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Used his magical eye to see through Harry Potter's Invisibility Cloak.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought successfully in multiple skirmishes before his death.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Ambushed in the sky during the Battle of the Seven Potters.

campaignTags.claim: Master wizard and veteran Auror capable of casting high-level magic.

unknowns: Exact circumstances of his fatal duel with Voldemort are off-screen.

characters.summary: Albus Dumbledore is widely regarded as the most powerful wizard of his age. He employs subtle, highly advanced magic, exceptional transfiguration, and encyclopedic knowledge of magical theory.
weaknesses: Emotional vulnerability concerning Gellert Grindelwald and his sister Ariana
Cursed hand from Marvolo Gaunt's ring
limitations: Physical stamina impaired by the curse on Marvolo Gaunt's ring.

sources.supports: Albus Dumbledore's magical prowess, history, and feats.

feats.claim: Dueled Lord Voldemort to a standstill in the Ministry of Magic Atrium.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

feats.claim: Subdued dozens of Death Eaters and controlled massive water and fire elements simultaneously.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought evenly until Voldemort possessed Harry Potter.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Legendary 1945 duel where Dumbledore won despite Grindelwald wielding the Elder Wand.

campaignTags.claim: Master of virtually all known forms of magic.
Demonstrated advanced control over magical fire to trap opponents.

unknowns: Exact details of the 1945 duel with Grindelwald beyond the outcome.

characters.summary: This version of Albus Dumbledore wields the Elder Wand, amplifying his already immense magical power to unprecedented levels.

mechanisms: Impenetrable magical shields boosted by the Elder Wand

weaknesses: Subject to the same physical vulnerabilities and emotional attachments as base Dumbledore
limitations: Wand allegiance rules can transfer mastery if disarmed.
characters.formDifferences: Equipped with the Elder Wand, which significantly amplifies the scale, power, and versatility of his spellcasting.

sources.supports: The power enhancements granted by the Elder Wand.

feats.claim: Defeated Gellert Grindelwald in 1945 while Grindelwald was master of the Elder Wand.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Wields the most powerful wand in existence to cast peerless magic.
Carries and utilizes the Elder Wand.

unknowns: Whether Dumbledore ever unlocked the theoretical mastery of conquering death associated with the Deathsticks.

characters.summary: Amelia Bones was the Head of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement. Described as a brilliant, fair, and powerful witch who put up a fierce fight when attacked.

techniques: Advanced defensive and offensive dueling spells

sources.supports: Amelia Bones' career as Head of DMLE and her strong dueling reputation.

feats.claim: Put up a fierce struggle against Lord Voldemort before being killed.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
notableResults.note: Killed in her home by Voldemort after an intense battle.

campaignTags.claim: Highly accomplished witch and Head of Magical Law Enforcement.

unknowns: Specific spells used in her final confrontation are not documented.

characters.summary: Aragog is an Acromantula, a massive sentient spider capable of human speech and commanding colonies of giant spiders. He relies on physical size, venom, and swarming offspring.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to bright light and fire
limitations: Immobile due to massive size and advanced age.

sources.supports: Aragog's size, traits as an Acromantula, and colony leadership.

feats.claim: Led a colony of hundreds of Acromantulas in the Forbidden Forest.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

campaignTags.claim: An Acromantula the size of a small elephant.

unknowns: Combat capabilities in his youth before growing old and frail.

characters.summary: Argus Filch is the non-magical (Squib) caretaker of Hogwarts School. He possesses no magical abilities and relies on his knowledge of the castle, a cat companion, and physical traps or weapons.
limitations: Cannot cast spells or use magical artifacts effectively.

sources.supports: Argus Filch's status as a Squib and Hogwarts caretaker.

feats.claim: Maintained discipline across Hogwarts alongside his cat Mrs. Norris.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

unknowns: Any formal combat training beyond basic school discipline.

characters.summary: Arthur Weasley is a wizard employed by the Ministry of Magic, specializing in Muggle artifacts. While not a frontline combatant, he is capable of standard defensive and offensive magic.
weaknesses: Limited combat experience compared to dedicated fighters
limitations: Prefers administrative and artifact work over active combat.

sources.supports: Arthur Weasley's employment at the Ministry and magical skills.

feats.claim: Fought in the Order of the Phoenix and survived encounters with Death Eaters.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Severely wounded by Nagini guarding the Department of Mysteries.

campaignTags.claim: Qualified wizard capable of casting household and combat spells.
Known for enchanting and modifying Muggle artifacts.

unknowns: Full record of his dueling wins against individual Death Eaters.

characters.summary: Barty Crouch Jr. is an intensely loyal and gifted Death Eater. He is proficient in high-level dark magic, including the Unforgivable Curses, and executed an elaborate infiltration of Hogwarts using Polyjuice Potion.
limitations: Requires constant supply of Polyjuice Potion when maintaining an alias.

sources.supports: Barty Crouch Jr.'s mastery of dark magic and the Unforgivable Curses.

feats.claim: Mastered all three Unforgivable Curses to an extent that fooled Albus Dumbledore's staff.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Overpowered Alastor Moody in a surprise ambush.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
notableResults.note: Ambushed Moody with Peter Pettigrew prior to the school year.

campaignTags.claim: Proficient in casting the Imperius Curse.
Successfully impersonated Alastor Moody for a full school year using Polyjuice Potion.

unknowns: Extent of his magical skill without the element of surprise.

characters.summary: The Basilisk is a massive serpent bred by Dark Wizards, possessing lethal venom and a gaze that kills instantly. Its thick scales deflect most spells.

mechanisms: Impenetrable scales that deflect standard spells

weaknesses: Vulnerability to the crowing of a rooster
Vulnerability to direct attacks to its soft eye interiors
limitations: Blindness caused by physical damage renders gaze attack useless.

sources.supports: Basilisk abilities, instant death gaze, and venomous bite.

feats.claim: Lived for a thousand years inside the Chamber of Secrets.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

feats.claim: Killed victims instantly merely by direct eye contact.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Slain by Harry Potter using the Sword of Gryffindor after being blinded.

campaignTags.claim: A massive serpent over fifty feet long.

unknowns: Exact resistance to high-tier magical attacks beyond standard spells.
